buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name WCL, WANI NORTH AREA Account No. 11212045702 IFSC Code SBIN0000504 Bank Name SBI Branch address

WANI . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of WCL, WANI NORTH AREA A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK Transportation, Loading and unloading work of 24 nos iron cages containing 27.35 MT standard weights fo r 09 days in every three months (110 km distance) through different mines of WCL Wani North Area via tr ailer for two-year period. The Scope of Work includes: 1. The said work is to be carried out once every quarter for two-year contract duration i.e., a total of 8 times (8x9 days =72 days). 2. Schedule for the above transportation (testing of weighbridges) activity will be informed 05 days in advance for carrying out the work. 3. Successful bidder to provide 1 no of trailer / truck with a carrying capacity o f about 30T Crane along with driver and helper/supervisor. The trailer shall be stationed at the completed weighbridge or at the next scheduled weighbridge a t the end of each day after the testing activity. (This arrangement will be requir ed for 9 days during each quarter.) 4. Loading of Cages at Area Store: Loading of 24 iron cages (containing a t otal of 27.5 MT of standard weights) onto trailers/trucks using a crane, from the Area Store. The crane and transportation arrangement will be provided by the v endor. 5. Transportation to Weighbridges: Transportation of the loaded cages fro m the Area Store to the designated weighbridge locations across Wani North Ar ea.

6. Unloading at Weighbridge: Unloading cages onto the platform of the wei ghbridge using a crane for the purpose of weighbridge testing. 7. Reloading After Testing: Once testing is completed, the cages are to be reloaded onto the trailer/truck using a crane. 8. Repetition Across All Locations: The activities mentioned in points 3 an d 4 (unloading and reloading) will be repeated at each of the 14/15 weighbridge s installed at various locations in the Wani North Area. 9. Final Unloading at Area Store: After completion of testing at the 14th/15 th and final weighbridge, the cages will be reloaded and transported back to th e Area Store of Wani North Area, where they will be unloaded, completing the c ycle initiated at the start of the operation. 10. The loaded trailer will transport the cages from regional store to weighbridg es in Ukni OC mine, Junad OC Mine, Pimpalgaon OC Mine, Kolarpimpri OC Mine, Wani Railway Siding, Ghonsa OC Mine and Rajur UG Mine and as per WCL WNA requirement. Terms & Conditions of Contract: 1. Completion Period: - Completion period of work is 730 (Seven Hund red Thirty) Days. 2. Payment of Bill :- All running on account bill shall be paid at 95 % (Ninety fi ve percent) of the work value. The balance 5 % (Five percent) shall be treated a s retention money and will be second part of security deposit / Retention money shall be refunded after issue of no Defect certificate. 3. Paying Authority: - Area Finance Manager, WCL, Wani North Area 4. Bill should be submitted through ANO (E&T), AHQ, WNA to SO(E&M), Wani N orth Area with necessary certification of satisfactory completion of work. 5. A crane along with one qualified driver and two helpers/supervisors shall be provided by the vendor (C-Link) for the loading and unloading of iron cages at e ach weighbridge location. 6. A trailer/truck along with one driver and one helper/supervisor shall also be provided by the vendor for the transportation of iron cages between weighbridg es and the Area Store.

7. A total of 2 nos. of C-links with crane shall be provided by the vendor for the complete duration of the weighbridge testing activity. 8. At the end of each day, the trailer/truck shall be loaded with the cages and parked near the weighbridge where testing was completed for the day or at the next scheduled weighbridge, depending on operational convenience. 9. Accommodation, food, and local logistics for all personnel involved— including drivers and helpers/supervisors of both crane and trailer/truck—shall b e the responsibility of the vendor. 10. The vendor shall be solely responsible for the safety and security of the cag es during transportation between locations. 11. All cages must be properly tied with ropes or other suitable securing metho ds to prevent any movement or accidental fall during transportation. 12. If any damage occurs to the cages or standard weights during the execution of the specified scope of work, the cost of repair or replacement shall be deduct ed from the ongoing work payment or recovered from the vendor as deemed ap propriate. 13. Transportation, Tools and tackles required for carrying out the subject work are part of the scope of work and to be arranged by the bidder only. 14. Proper safety gears must be ensured by the bidder during each time of loading/ unloading of cages at each mine. 15. Safety of working men Drivers, Helpers and Supervisors is sole responsible of vendor/ contractor . . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
